Method
• Support a cup in the 250 cm beaker.
• Use the measuring cylinder to transfer 25.0 cm of FA 2 into the cup.
• Place the thermometer into FA 2 and tilt the cup, if necessary, so that the bulb is
fully covered.
• Measure the temperature of the solution in the cup. Record this temperature.
• Weigh the container with FA 1. Record the mass.
• Transfer small quantities of FA 1 into the cup containing FA 2 until all the FA 1 is added.
• Stir the mixture. Measure the minimum temperature reached. Record this value.
• Calculate and record the temperature change.
• Weigh the container with any residual FA 1. Record the mass.
• Calculate and record the mass of FA 1 used.
